response.rationale: Several T1 meta-analyses (Norris 2000, Spada 2010, Goo 2015, Kang 2019) find explicit instruction beats implicit, with supporting T3 studies, but the evidence is qualified: gains are smaller on spontaneous speech and delayed tests, and two T6 sources (Paradis 2009; Winke 2013) argue explicit knowledge doesn't become implicit competence or produce measurable learning, so the support is strong but not unqualified.
